title: Jonathan Canyons 100K Crew Guide
subtitle: Compact 13-hour working plan. All ETAs and leg paces are planning estimates; official course markings and race-week updates win.
versionNote: Version: generated compact draft, 13-hour schedule. Next pass: exact target time, maps, parking screenshots, and product-specific fuel math.

crewStops.name: Michigan Bluff
crewStops.summary: Meet near aid station with go-bag, enough Naak gels for the next segment, and an optional extra filled bottle.

crewStops.name: Foresthill
crewStops.summary: Meet near aid station with go-bag, Naak gels for the next segment, bladder refill to 1L, and an optional extra filled bottle.

crewStops.name: Drivers Flat
crewStops.summary: Meet near aid station with go-bag, Naak gels for the next segment, bladder refill to 1L, and an optional extra filled bottle.

stops.name: China Wall Start
stops.note: Runner-only shuttle. Leave with the first long-leg fuel loaded.
stops.resupplyNote: Use Deadwood full aid. Carry enough preferred fuel for the no-food Devils Thumb loop.

stops.name: Deadwood 1
stops.note: Refill and keep enough food for the Devils Thumb loop through Deadwood 2.

stops.name: Swinging Bridge
stops.note: Reset for the steep climb back to Devils Thumb.

stops.name: Deadwood 2
stops.note: Refill for the push to first crew. Start heat management early.

stops.name: Michigan Bluff
stops.crewCallout: CREW HERE: arrive by 8:00 AM and meet near the aid station. Have the go-bag ready, enough Naak gels for the next segment, and an optional extra filled bottle. Fast handoff: bottles, cooling, sunscreen, trash, quick stomach and feet check.
stops.resupplyNote: Short crew-to-crew block. Keep the handoff fast and leave with simple calories.

stops.name: Foresthill
stops.crewCallout: CREW HERE: arrive by 9:35 AM and meet near the aid station. Have the go-bag ready, enough Naak gels for the next segment, and be ready to take the bladder and fill it to the 1L mark. Optional extra filled bottle ready too. Main reset: bottles, drop bag, socks/body glide if needed, matzah, and fuel for Cal Street.
stops.resupplyNote: Longest crew-to-crew block. Use Cal 2 full aid, but leave Foresthill with the block covered.

stops.name: Cal 2
stops.note: Long no-crew leg follows. Refill hard here.

stops.name: Drivers Flat
stops.crewCallout: CREW HERE: arrive by 1:00 PM and meet near the aid station. Have the go-bag ready, enough Naak gels for the next segment, and be ready to take the bladder and fill it to the 1L mark. Optional extra filled bottle ready too. Last handoff: calories through the finish, roast / pep talk, confidence, and decisive exit.
stops.resupplyNote: Final personal-fuel load. Add light, warm layer, and enough finish fuel to avoid bargaining.

stops.name: Mammoth Bar
stops.note: Eat if possible. The finish is close enough to simplify, not close enough to stop fueling.

stops.name: Confluence
stops.note: Final aid. Calories, fluid, then climb to Auburn.

stops.name: Downtown Auburn Finish
stops.note: Warm layer, dry shoes, simple food, and no complicated decisions.
